display.purpose: Modal target title — the largest statement in the system.

body.purpose: General copy, statuses, descriptions. 12-13px density is deliberate.

label.purpose: Uppercase micro-labels: platform chips, eyebrows, counts, tags.

counter.purpose: Media counter — the only 800 weight in the system.

shadows.name: fab-ambient
shadows.purpose: Detaches the floating launch button from the host page.

shadows.name: fab-ambient-hover
shadows.purpose: FAB hover lift; pairs with translateY(-2px).

shadows.name: modal-structural
shadows.purpose: Lifts the modal shell over the 0.78 scrim.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Platform-accent fill for the main scan action; recolors with the active platform theme.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #e1306c; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 12px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bordered dark button for quick scans (Posts, Stories, Galleries); hover steps up one tonal level.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #1c1c1f; border: 1px solid #2e2e33; color: #9e9ea7; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 10px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #26262b; color: #f0f0f2; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #2c2c33; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e1306c; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Download Button
components.description: The Go Green save action; the only green in the system. Dark Ink Base text for contrast.
components.css: .ds-btn-download { background: #34d27b; color: #121214; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 12px; width: 100%; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-download:hover { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-btn-download:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-download:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #121214; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Cancel Button
components.description: Outline-only Halt Red danger action; hover adds a translucent red wash, never a fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-cancel { background: transparent; border: 1px solid #e5484d; color: #e5484d; border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-cancel:hover { background: rgba(229, 72, 77, 0.15); } .ds-btn-cancel:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e5484d; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Platform Chip
components.description: Pill identity chip for the detected platform; Instagram uses the brand gradient, Facebook/Reddit use solid accents.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e1306c, #fd1d1d, #f56040); color: #ffffff; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 3px 9px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-chip-fb { background: #1877f2; } .ds-chip-reddit { background: #ff4500; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat bordered dark well for target info and notices; eyebrow + title pattern carries the hierarchy.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #1c1c1f; border: 1px solid #2e2e33; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; color: #f0f0f2; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-card-eyebrow { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #6e6e77; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #f0f0f2; margin-top: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Tabs
components.description: Horizontally scrollable media filter tabs; active tab = Hover Step background + platform accent text.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-tab { background: transparent; border: none; color: #9e9ea7; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #f0f0f2; } .ds-tab-active { background: #26262b; color: #e1306c; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e1306c; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Media Grid Item
components.description: Signature component: square dark-well thumbnail; selection is a 2px accent border plus a corner check overlay; corner tags mark format/resolution.
components.html:
MP4
✓4K
components.css: .ds-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 64px); gap: 6px; } .ds-grid-item { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; background: #242429; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.1s ease; } .ds-grid-item:hover { transform: scale(1.02); } .ds-grid-item-selected { border-color: #e1306c; } .ds-check { position: absolute; top: 4px; right: 4px; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 4px; background: #e1306c; border: 1px solid #e1306c; color: #ffffff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-grid-tag { position: absolute; bottom: 4px; left: 4px; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75); color: #ffffff; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-grid-tag-res { left: auto; right: 4px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Sunken tray radio group for the download format (In Folders / ZIP Archive); checked face steps up to Segment Step.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; background: #141417; border: 1px solid #2e2e33; border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px; gap: 2px; } .ds-segment { display: flex; cursor: pointer; position: relative; } .ds-segment input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; } .ds-segment-face { padding: 6px 12px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #9e9ea7; border-radius: 4px; transition: all 0.15s; } .ds-segment input:checked + .ds-segment-face { background: #2c2c33; color: #ffffff; } .ds-segment input:focus-visible + .ds-segment-face { outline: 2px solid #e1306c; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: Pill-track progress with accent fill and 11px/600 header; the fill recolors with the platform theme.
components.css: .ds-progress { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; width: 200px; } .ds-progress-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #f0f0f2; } .ds-progress-track { width: 100%; height: 6px; background: #121214; border-radius: 9999px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress-fill { height: 100%; background: #e1306c; transition: width 0.2s ease; }

narrative.overview:
The Darkroom Archive treats every SMD surface as the antechamber to the photographs themselves. Surfaces are near-black operator chrome — quiet, dense, monochrome — so that the media being archived is the only hero on screen. Color is scarce and functional: one platform accent at a time acts as the safelight, marking what belongs to the current platform; green is reserved for the act of saving; red only appears when the user must stop something. Nothing is decorative; every hue is a status, and every pixel of chrome exists to frame, select, and package the user's archive.

Density is a feature, not a compromise. This is a 400px popup and an in-page modal competing with a live social feed for attention; controls are compact (11–13px labels, 6–8px rhythm) and confident — bordered, quick to parse, unambiguous about state. The system must remain soft and friendly at the edges: pill chips, fully rounded progress tracks, gentle 6–12px radii, and forgiving hover states keep the instrument feel from turning clinical. The stance is anti-marketing: no gradients except the Instagram brand gradient, no colored fills without status meaning, no decorative imagery in chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black monochrome surfaces (#121214 base, #1c1c1f cards, #2e2e33 borders); media and accents supply all color.
One accent at a time: the platform accent recolors primary actions, selection, and progress as a set (magenta / signal blue / orangered), never mixed on screen.
State-coded action colors: green = save/download, red = cancel/danger, platform accent = platform identity + selection.
Compact confident controls: 11–13px type, 6px radius, 1px borders, tight 6–8px rhythm.
Friendly geometry on dark: 9999px pills, fully rounded progress bars, 12px modal shell.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Only one platform accent appears at a time, and it recolors the whole accent set — buttons, selection borders, check overlays, progress, FAB, chip — as one coherent theme. Never mix two platform accents on screen.

rules.name: The Status-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Saturated color is status, never decoration. Green appears only on the download action; red only on cancel/danger; a platform accent only on platform identity and selection. If a surface needs color to look designed, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Gradient Exception Rule
rules.body: The only gradient is the Instagram brand gradient on the Instagram badge/chip; it is a brand asset carried from the platform's own identity, and it must never be generalized to other surfaces.

rules.name: The Weight-Carries-Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: No new font faces. Hierarchy comes from the system stack's weights (400/600/700/800), size steps of 9–18px, and uppercase 10–11px micro-labels — never from adding a typeface.

rules.name: The Flat-Panel Rule
rules.body: Surfaces inside the popup and modal are flat at rest; shadows belong exclusively to UI floating over third-party pages (FAB, modal shell) or to hover/active responses.

dos: Do recolor the entire accent set as a theme when the platform changes (buttons, selection borders, check overlays, progress, FAB, chip switch together).
Do keep every saturated color status-coded: green = save, red = stop, platform accent = identity/selection.
Do use 1px Hairline Borders + tonal layering for panel depth; reserve shadows for the FAB and modal shell.
Do keep type in the system stack; use weight (400/600/700/800), 9–18px steps, and uppercase 10–11px micro-labels for hierarchy.
Do keep the media grid square, accent-bordered on selection, with corner tags — it is the signature component.
donts: Don't add a second gradient; the Instagram badge gradient is the only one.
Don't mix two platform accents on one screen.
Don't introduce colored fills without status meaning (no decorative color in chrome).
Don't add shadows inside popup/modal panels — the Flat-Panel Rule.
Don't grow control sizes past 13px body / 11px labels; the compact operator density is deliberate (11–13px is the working range).
Don't add a new typeface; the system stack carries all hierarchy.
